map.输入腐蚀速率、初始壁厚与腐蚀裕量，计算剩余寿命与建议检测周期: Enter corrosion rate, initial wall thickness and corrosion allowance to compute remaining life and recommended inspection interval
map.剩余寿命 = (初始壁厚 − 已用量 − 腐蚀裕量) / 腐蚀速率: Remaining life = (initial wall thickness minus used amount minus corrosion allowance) / corrosion rate
map.依据腐蚀速率、初始壁厚、腐蚀裕量与已使用年限，结合环境等级估算耐腐蚀剩余寿命，为: Based on corrosion rate, initial wall thickness, corrosion allowance and years in service, combined with environment grade, estimate corrosion-resistant remaining life, providing decision basis for inspection and replacement planning.
map.💡 剩余寿命 = (初始壁厚 - 腐蚀裕量 - 已腐蚀量) / 腐蚀速率；检测周: Remaining life = (initial wall thickness minus corrosion allowance minus corroded amount) / corrosion rate; inspection interval = remaining life / 3
map.腐蚀裕量是设计预留的允许腐蚀厚度，不可用作承压: Corrosion allowance is the reserved allowable corrosion thickness in design, not to be used for pressure bearing
map.实际腐蚀速率受温度、湿度、介质浓度等多因素影响: Actual corrosion rate is affected by temperature, humidity, medium concentration and other factors
map.建议检测周期取剩余寿命的 1/3，确保安全裕度: Recommended inspection interval takes one third of remaining life for safety margin
map.📚 深度解析：耐腐蚀寿命（壁厚减薄与检测周期）: In-depth: Corrosion Resistance Life (wall thickness reduction and inspection interval)
map.设备定寿：按腐蚀速率与腐蚀裕量算总寿命与剩余寿命: Equipment life determination: compute total life and remaining life by corrosion rate and allowance
map.在役管道评估：输入已用年限算当前壁厚与完好率: In-service pipe assessment: input years in service to compute current wall thickness and integrity rate
map.检修计划：按剩余寿命的 1/3 确定检测周期: Inspection plan: determine inspection interval by one third of remaining life
map.算法：环境修正系数按 1~4 级取 [1, 1.5, 2.5, 4]，对应常规大: Algorithm: environment correction coefficient by grade 1 to 4 takes [1, 1.5, 2.5, 4], corresponding to normal atmosphere / industrial atmosphere / marine atmosphere / chemical medium; corrected corrosion rate = input rate times coefficient; corroded amount = corrected rate times years in service; current wall thickness = initial wall thickness minus corroded amount; total design life = (initial wall thickness minus corrosion allowance) / corrected rate; remaining life = total life minus years in service; recommended inspection interval = remaining life / 3; wall integrity rate = current wall thickness / initial wall thickness times 100%.
map.例：碳钢管 0.1mm/年、初始壁厚 10mm、裕量 2mm、常规大气、未使用: Example: carbon steel pipe 0.1 mm/year, initial wall thickness 10 mm, allowance 2 mm, normal atmosphere, unused gives corrected rate 0.1 mm/year, total life 80 years, remaining 80 years, inspection interval 26.7 years, integrity 100%, ample life, normal use. Change to marine atmosphere (coefficient 2.5) and 20 years in service gives corrected rate 0.25 mm/year, corroded 5 mm, current wall thickness 5 mm, total life 32 years, remaining 12 years, inspection interval 4 years, integrity 50%. If chemical medium (coefficient 4) and 18 years in service gives corrected rate 0.4 mm/year, corroded 7.2 mm, wall thickness 2.8 mm, remaining life 2 years, integrity 28%, limited remaining life, increase inspection frequency.
map.一般在计算壁厚之外预留 1~3mm，或按设计寿命×腐蚀速率反推。强腐蚀介质、难以: Generally reserve 1 to 3 mm beyond the calculated wall thickness, or back-calculate by design life times corrosion rate. Strong corrosive media, hard-to-inspect or serious-consequence parts should take a high value; the allowance directly offsets the corrodible thickness and greatly affects life.
map.检测周期为什么取剩余寿命的 1/3？: Why is the inspection interval one third of remaining life?
map.工程惯例要求在一个检测周期内至少能观察到两次明显劣化趋势，保证在失效前有干预窗口: Engineering practice requires observing at least two clear degradation trends within one inspection interval, ensuring an intervention window before failure. When the corrosion rate is unstable or the failure consequence is serious, it should be further shortened.
map.关于「耐腐蚀寿命」: About the Corrosion Resistance Life tool
map.耐腐蚀寿命计算器根据材料腐蚀速率、初始壁厚和腐蚀裕量，结合环境等级修正，计算设备: The corrosion resistance life calculator computes the remaining life, current wall thickness and recommended inspection interval of equipment and pipes based on material corrosion rate, initial wall thickness and corrosion allowance, combined with environment grade correction, providing decision basis for corrosion protection and equipment management.
map.支持常规、工业、海洋、化学四种环境等级修正: Supports four environment grade corrections: normal, industrial, marine, chemical
